mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and corporate output, which boosts investor confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and retail sales signals a strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative investor sentiment and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressures, which erodes purchasing power and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which leads to negative investor sentiment and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST decreases by more than 5% in a month.
